_readme: Copy this folder to setup/demos/<word>/ where <word> is the private path (squarenumbers.co.uk/preview/<word>). Fill in every field, add knowledge/*.md files and an optional logo.png, then run: node scripts/demo-build.js. Generate a password with: node scripts/demo-build.js --password

business.name: Example Bakery
business.type: an independent bakery and café in Cambridge

bot.name: Example Bakery assistant
bot.welcomeMessage: Hi, I'm the Example Bakery assistant. Ask me about the menu, opening hours, cakes, or anything else.
bot.inputPlaceholder: Ask about the menu, hours, or cakes
suggestedQuestions: What time do you open on Sunday?
What could the full version do for us?
bot.fallback: I can't help with that one here, but the Example Bakery team can: their details are in the buttons below.

branding.fontStack: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

realVersionCapabilities: Live on the business's own website, on every page, in its own look
Answers from the real menu, hours and policies, which the team can update without a developer
Takes enquiries and emails them to the team, with the customer's details, only after the customer confirms
Reports what customers asked most, so the website and FAQs can improve
